I understand in Islam that women and men shouldn't talk more than business. He asked me to delete the friends from my internet accounts who I didn't even talk to. He got angry with me when I asked him if he could do the same and delete them. He said that in Egypt men are allowed to but women can't (which is impossible anyway). answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 43448 Country: Pakistan Title: custom Question: It is like a bayhari family tradition that the bride’s side takes breakfast for the groom’s side the next day of wedding. Is doing this alright or does Islam forbid these kinds of actions? Answer ID: 43448 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 214/214/M=1434) If they practice it due to tradition and custom not willingly then it should be avoided but if it is not done due to tradition and custom and it is free from non-Shariah acts, then there is no harm in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
